title: Witness 'Ed': $34B and $40B scrubbed from Air Force books
place_text: Nevada Test and Training Range; Edwards AFB; Pentagon

tellings.quote: So, I covered once a witness code named Ed who talked of a joint reverse engineering program between the Nevada Test and Trade Range and Edwards Air Force Base.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels about a witness he covered, codenamed Ed. Ed spoke of a joint reverse engineering program, meaning an effort to study and copy unknown technology, between the Nevada Test and Training Range, a large military range in Nevada, and Edwards Air Force Base in California, linked to $34 billion and $40 billion said to have been scrubbed from Air Force books between 2012 and 2016. If true, it would mean huge sums were hidden to fund the work.
